formula: g(h) = G·M / (R+h)² ;  g₀ ≈ 9,81 N/kg à la surface
sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas showing an Earth cross-section with a "near
surface" zoomed region. Above the surface, g field drawn as uniform
downward arrows of magnitude g₀ = 9.81 N/kg; farther out, arrows
shrink and radiate 1/r². Sliders: altitude h (km), planet mass M.
Draggable test object shows local g(h) = G·M/(R+h)². HUD: g at test
point, ratio g(h)/g₀. Experiment: reach a target g(h) by choosing
altitude. Evaluate: field hidden; only altitude slider and target g
— student picks h. Wrinkle: the uniform-vs-radial distinction is the
pedagogical crux; R_Earth = 6400 km baked in.
